LESSON: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Parable on prayer Midnight

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Parable on prayer Midnight. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
2. appreciate the parable by praying to God always

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PARABLE ON PRAYER MIDNIGHT
This lesson teaches Parable on prayer Midnight for Grade 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the parable by praying to God always
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Parable on prayer Midnight using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Parable on prayer Midnight above.
2. Explain Parable on prayer Midnight to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Parable on prayer Midnight.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Parable on prayer Midnight with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Parable on prayer Midnight important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they pray daily. 1. Why should Christians pray at all times?
2. How do you exercise faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
2. appreciate the parable by praying to God always

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
